nom: RoC Retinol Correxion Deep Wrinkle Serum for Face and Neck

segments.dry: One reviewer with normal skin still developed dry, burning red patches after a few days of use, and another noted the reformulated serum dries out the skin like the cream version.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing their skin as sensitive generally tolerate the serum well ('surprisingly gentle', 'gentle for a retinol product'), though one sensitive-fragrance user got migraines from the scent and could not continue.
segments.normal: A reviewer with self-described normal skin developed dry, red, burning patches within days, while another with normal skin reports steady improvement in deep forehead wrinkles and smile lines with no irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 60s, 70s, 80s and even 90s report visible softening of deep wrinkles, firmer-looking skin, and being told they look years younger, with several describing this as a years-long routine rather than a quick fix.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visible softening of fine lines, forehead wrinkles, smile lines and crow's feet, often describing gradual results over weeks to months and needing consistent nightly use; a minority (deep forehead wrinkles after 30 days, or wrinkles that seemed to deepen) report no improvement or even a sense of worsening.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the serum leaving skin feeling soft, smooth, and velvety, but one reviewer with normal skin developed dry, red, burning patches, and another said the reformulated version dries the skin like the matching cream.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report initial stinging or a red face after application, especially with frequent use, though this is generally described as temporary or manageable by using the product sparingly at first.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with normal skin reported burning, dry, red spots that worsened with sweat, sunscreen or moisturizer, suggesting a reactive/compromised barrier response; most other reviewers report no such reaction.
concerns.spots: One reviewer specifically targeting dark spots from sun damage reported early positive results after about a week, with no dissenting reports on this specific concern in the reviews supplied.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer comparing this serum side-by-side with the ROC night cream reported breaking out by day 10, attributed to the silicones in the formula; no other reviewer mentions breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer explicitly describes the serum as silky and not oily despite visible smoothing effects; another reviewer following a reformulation complained the new version leaves an oily layer on the face.

aspects.libelle: Contains silicones that can trigger breakouts

extraits.texte: I have normal skin -- not dry, sensitive, oily, etc. -- but have been trying to reverse nasolabial wrinkles. A few days of using this product has given me dry, red spots that burn like no tomorrow, especially when I sweat even a bit or put on sunscreen/moisturizer/etc. It also smells awful. DO NOT GET.

extraits.titre: Perfect...if it wasn't for the silicones!
extraits.texte: I used this on one side whilst applying the ROC Retinol night cream on the other side of my face for a clear comparison between the two. I built up my skins' tolerance level which is something I suggest anyone new to retinol should do, by applying every 3rd day, then every 2nd and eventually nightly. I prefer the light texture of this to the night cream and that it doesn't sit on my skin but sinks in quite easily. Retinol does work! Even in the short amount of time that I used it my pores looked more refined and my skin tone overall fresher and smoother. However, with 3 types of silicones in the formulation that joy was short-lived. By day 10 I was already breaking out, despite the gaps in between use. Bottom line: if your skin does not like silicones, then go with a Retinol product that doesn't list 'Cyclopentasiloxane' or 'Dimethicone' in its ingredients list. Quick results., surprisingly gentle on my sensitive skin. I'll keep using to see if improvement on my fine lines., so far so good!

Got this on recommendation from my dermatologist who said no need to spend a ton of money on the more expensive products and that this one works great. She was right! I really love this and am so pleasantly surprised at the value for what you get. I've only used this for a week, and I already notice an improvement in the texture and brightness of my skin. Plus it's gentle for a retinol product which I love because I have slightly sensitive skin and don't like the stronger stuff for everyday use that makes my skin peel. I'm looking to fade dark spots from sun damage and this seems to be working already!

extraits.titre: Seems to work well on deep wrinkles
extraits.texte: I have been using this product for a month because I have deep wrinkles on my forehead, and deep smile lines around my mouth. It does not eliminate them, but they appear to be not as deep. I apply it every morning to my deep wrinkles after washing my face, followed by RoC's Hyaluronic Hydrate + Plump moisturizer. I repeat this in the evenings for 6 out of 7 days (on the 7th day I apply a glycolic acid to my face). This routine works well for me. My skin type is normal.

Okay, so as someone with deep forehead wrinkles, I'm always interested in retinol serums, and I had high hopes for this particular serum but after using for 30 days, I have seen no changes. I know it's soon to notice anything but Idk, I feel like they're getting deeper? I might be looking elsewhere soon for another serum as I feel this just isn't doing much.... or enough? Anywho, maybe if you don't have like super deep wrinkles this would work but for someone with super deep wrinkles... it's not working as well.

My first retinol. In comparison to spendier options: great for the value, smoothing of my skin texture and fine lines. Blurs imperfections. I use 4 days a week at night only, 2 days back to back, then a rest day using a heavy night moisturizer. I had to work in this product to get my skin used to it. Took about two weeks for my skin to accept the product without irritation. Worth it!
